name: abr-mcp
description: Validate, look up and search ABNs and ACNs. Unofficial; not affiliated with or endorsed by the ABR.
long_description: Offline ABN/ACN checksum validation, plus lookups and name search via the live ABN Lookup web services (with your own free GUID) or an offline index built from the weekly ABN Bulk Extract. Every answer carries provenance and the data licence. This is an independent, unofficial client: it is not affiliated with, endorsed or approved by the Australian Business Register or the Commonwealth.

abr_guid.title: ABN Lookup GUID
abr_guid.description: Free from abr.business.gov.au/Tools/WebServices. Enables live lookups and name search.

index_path.title: Local index (optional)
index_path.description: abr.sqlite built with `abr-mcp update-index`, for offline and bulk use.

tools.name: validate_abn
tools.description: Check an ABN's format and checksum offline.

tools.name: validate_acn
tools.description: Check an ACN/ARBN's format and checksum offline.

tools.name: lookup_abn
tools.description: Get the ABR record for one ABN.

tools.name: lookup_abns
tools.description: Validate and look up many ABNs at once.

tools.name: lookup_acn
tools.description: Find the ABN record(s) for an ACN.

tools.name: search_names
tools.description: Search ABR names for candidate ABNs.
